compiled_pdf_reproducibility.note: Three clean isolated Tectonic builds produced the same 20-page, zero-error, zero-undefined-reference, zero-overfull-box document but different PDF bytes. The compiled_pdf_sha256 field identifies the build whose 20 rendered pages received the visual audit; the deterministic source tarball, rather than generated PDF bytes, is the retention invariant.

visual_audit.note: All 20 isolated-build pages were rendered at 110 dpi and inspected in a 4-by-5 contact sheet. No clipping, cross-column overlap, or missing figure was observed.
